Archive_test\wiki\edge_of_gloamreach.md:5:**Edge of Gloamreach** is a grimoire associated with [[Blackford]], where it was forged and is housed. Its attunement cost is **46**. The artifact presents the visual identity of a grimoire bearing the name **Edge of Gloamreach**, while its demeanor suggests a shadowed and twilight-bound atmosphere. The date on which [[Edge of Gloamreach]] was forged is not recorded in the supplied facts, and the forged date remains contested among sources; readers are directed to the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]] as the authorities on the matter.
Archive_test\wiki\edge_of_gloamreach.md:20:[[Edge of Gloamreach]] is classified as a **grimoire**, placing it among artifacts whose identity is defined by written or inscribed arcane form. The available record does not preserve a forging year for the artifact. Although sources dispute the forged date of [[Edge of Gloamreach]], no year should be assigned to it. The [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]] are the designated authorities for consultation regarding this disputed field.
Archive_test\wiki\edge_of_gloamreach.md:36:The [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]] have a distinct documentary role. They are identified as the authorities to consult concerning the contested forged date of [[Edge of Gloamreach]]. This does not establish that either work is affiliated with the grimoire; their relevance is limited to the disputed historical field. No year is to be stated for the forging of [[Edge of Gloamreach]] unless the record is revised by an authoritative source.
Archive_test\wiki\edge_of_gloamreach.md:50:The attunement cost does not establish the grimoire’s forging date, its place of origin, or its affiliations. Those fields remain separate. The confirmed historical location is [[Blackford]], where [[Edge of Gloamreach]] was forged and where it is housed. The disputed forged date remains without a stated year, with the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]] serving as the authorities for that question.
Archive_test\wiki\emberdeep.md:14:| Founded | Contested among sources; consult [[Annals/Codex]] |
Archive_test\wiki\emberdeep.md:20:The founding of [[Emberdeep]] is contested among sources. No year is established here. Readers seeking the authoritative treatment of its founding should consult the [[Annals/Codex]], which serves as the authority for the matter. Accounts that differ from one another should therefore not be treated as settled chronology without reference to that source.
Archive_test\wiki\emberdeep.md:48:References to the settlement’s origins are often treated with caution because the founding of [[Emberdeep]] is contested among sources. The disputed founding has contributed to the site’s indistinct place in collective memory, but it does not authorize a specific date. The [[Annals/Codex]] remains the authority to which readers are directed when examining the question of its founding.
Archive_test\wiki\gauntlet_of_sorrowfell.md:5:The **[[Gauntlet of Sorrowfell]]** is an artifact of the regalia class, distinguished by an atmosphere of sorrow and grim authority. Its attunement cost is **12**. The gauntlet was forged at **[[Vharencrag Fortress]]** and is housed in **[[Greyfell Citadel]]**. Although its place of forging and present housing are recorded, the date of its forging is not established in the supplied records; accounts concerning the forging remain contested and should be referred to the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] for authoritative treatment.
Archive_test\wiki\gauntlet_of_sorrowfell.md:20:The date on which the gauntlet was forged is not recorded in the supplied facts. The forging account is contested among sources, and no year should be assigned to it. References that attempt to place the forging within a specific year are therefore not treated as settled information in this article. Readers requiring the authoritative discussion of the disputed forging should consult the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\gauntlet_of_sorrowfell.md:36:The disputed forging accounts also do not constitute a confirmed affiliation. Competing descriptions of the forging may be relevant to interpretation, but they do not authorize the attribution of the gauntlet to an unnamed or unrecorded party. The [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] remain the proper authorities for the contested account of the forging, while this article records only the undisputed location and classification data.
Archive_test\wiki\gauntlet_of_sorrowfell.md:48:Taken together, the known details produce an artifact whose documented profile is deliberately austere. The **[[Gauntlet of Sorrowfell]]** is regalia; its attunement cost is **12**; it was forged at **[[Vharencrag Fortress]]**; it is housed in **[[Greyfell Citadel]]**; and it presents an atmosphere of sorrow and grim authority. Its forging date is not recorded in the supplied facts, and the contested accounts of its forging are to be addressed through the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]], rather than resolved through speculation.
Archive_test\wiki\gloamreach.md:18:| Founded | Contested; consult the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] |
Archive_test\wiki\gloamreach.md:22:The recorded history of [[Gloamreach]] is inseparable from the uncertainty surrounding its foundation. Sources contest when the location was founded, and no founding year is accepted as definitive. Accordingly, no year should be assigned to its establishment. The [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] remain the authorities for examination of the disputed record and should be consulted in place of later summaries that attempt to settle the matter without resolving the underlying disagreement.
Archive_test\wiki\gloamreach.md:30:The surviving account of [[Gloamreach]] is consequently layered. Its regional identity is clear, its current authority is clear, and its garrison strength is recorded precisely. Its beginnings, however, remain contested. This combination of certainty and uncertainty contributes to the location’s guarded reputation: its present condition can be stated directly, while its origins resist a single authoritative chronology outside the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\ashreach.md:14:The founding of Ashreach is contested among sources. No year for its founding should be treated as authoritative. Readers seeking the accepted record should consult the [[Annals/Codex]], which serves as the authority for the matter while the competing accounts remain unresolved.
Archive_test\wiki\ashreach.md:34:No uncontested founding affiliation can be established from the available accounts. The founding of Ashreach is contested among sources, and the [[Annals/Codex]] should be consulted as the authority rather than replaced by an unsupported date or simplified origin story. The disputed character of the founding does not alter Ashreach’s present regional placement or ruling affiliation, but it does limit the certainty with which its earliest history can be described.
Archive_test\wiki\ashreach.md:58:The disputed founding contributes to the same impression. Without an uncontested founding year, Ashreach’s origin remains a matter for the [[Annals/Codex]] rather than a settled point of common record. Its past is consequently approached with the same caution as its present. The settlement is known, ruled, defended, and regionally defined, but never entirely beyond dispute.
Archive_test\wiki\marrowwell_abbey.md:3:[[Marrowwell Abbey]] is a rebuilt religious stronghold standing in [[The Gloaming Reach]]. Ruled by [[The Bleeding Crown]], it maintains a garrison of 6656 despite not being a core holding. Its rebuilt form presents a severe, marrow-white silhouette beneath the dim character of the Reach, while its overall demeanor combines religious austerity with military vigilance. The date of its founding is contested among sources and is not established here; readers seeking the authoritative treatment should consult the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\marrowwell_abbey.md:18:The history of [[Marrowwell Abbey]] is inseparable from the uncertainty surrounding its foundation. Sources disagree over when the abbey was founded, and no year is given here. The dispute is treated as a matter for the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]], which remain the authorities for the contested record. Any account that presents a definitive founding year without reference to that disagreement should therefore be treated with caution.
Archive_test\wiki\marrowwell_abbey.md:50:In descriptions of the location, the most reliable emphasis should therefore remain on the established combination of qualities: rebuilt, severe, marrow-white, religiously austere, and militarily vigilant. The abbey’s identity is strongest when these elements are considered together. Its contested foundation belongs to the authority of the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]]; its present character is the rebuilt stronghold standing in [[The Gloaming Reach]], ruled by [[The Bleeding Crown]], and maintaining a garrison of 6656.
Archive_test\wiki\mournwatch.md:18:The history of [[Mournwatch]] is inseparable from the uncertainty surrounding its foundation. Sources disagree over when the settlement was founded, and the matter remains contested. No year is accepted as definitive. Readers seeking an authoritative treatment of the dispute should consult the [[Annals]] and the [[Codex]], which are the recognized authorities for the question of [[Mournwatch]]’s foundation.
Archive_test\wiki\mournwatch.md:26:Because the foundation is disputed, descriptions of [[Mournwatch]] are best separated into two categories. The first consists of the matters firmly established by the record: its region, the [[Gloaming Reach]], its garrisoned status, its position outside the realm’s core holdings, and its rule by [[The Bleeding Crown]]. The second consists of the contested or interpretive material surrounding its beginnings, for which the [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] remain the proper references.
Archive_test\wiki\mournwatch.md:52:The disputed founding remains a recurring point of reference in discussions of [[Mournwatch]]. Because sources contest the matter, no year should be given as fact. The [[Annals]] and [[Codex]] remain the appropriate authorities for readers wishing to compare the competing accounts.

Archive_test\wiki\the_cinder_wrought_aegis.md:17:The **[[The Cinder-Wrought Aegis]]** was forged at [[Embermarch]]. This place of forging is the clearest fixed point in the artifact’s recorded history, although the sources disagree about the circumstances and period of its creation. The forged of **[[The Cinder-Wrought Aegis]]** is contested among sources, and no single account is accepted as definitive. Readers seeking authority on that question are directed to the [[Annals/Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\the_cinder_wrought_aegis.md:21:The **[[The Cinder-Wrought Aegis]]** is housed in [[Gloamreach]]. Its placement there establishes the artifact’s principal known repository, while also reinforcing the distinction between its place of forging and its place of preservation. The available record does not provide a confirmed account of every stage between those locations. Accordingly, descriptions of any unrecorded passage, transfer, or custodianship should be treated as conjectural unless supported by the [[Annals/Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\the_cinder_wrought_aegis.md:31:Nor does the known housing of the **[[The Cinder-Wrought Aegis]]** in [[Gloamreach]] establish that the location and the artifact share an institutional or political affiliation. [[Gloamreach]] is the artifact’s recorded place of housing, while [[Embermarch]] is its recorded place of forging. These statements identify locations associated with the regalia and should not be expanded into claims about ownership or patronage without support from the [[Annals/Codex]].
Archive_test\wiki\the_cinder_wrought_aegis.md:47:Because the forged of the **[[The Cinder-Wrought Aegis]]** is contested among sources, later interpretations must distinguish documented fact from attribution. The [[Annals/Codex]] remains the authority to consult when assessing that dispute. Until the matter is resolved there, the artifact’s significance rests not upon a supplied year or an accepted maker, but upon the stable evidence of its class, appearance, purpose, and known locations.

Its walls, towers, and enclosed approaches are read against wet ground, dim horizons, and the persistent severity of the surrounding landscape. The result is not an isolated architectural style, but a place whose appearance is defined by its setting. Crookgate Keep presents as a stronghold made severe by the marsh around it.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its demeanor is correspondingly uncertain. The atmosphere of Crookgate Keep is marked by its contested status: authority is present, but the permanence of that authority is not treated as settled. Records therefore describe the keep through condition rather than confidence. It is held, but not regarded as secure; administered, but not removed from dispute. This uncertainty is a defining feature of the location and should be considered alongside its formal designation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The keep’s position outside the realm’s core holdings further determines its gazetteer classification. Crookgate Keep is not entered among the central possessions of the realm. Its geographic separation and contested status are recorded as distinct conditions, neither replacing the other.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The accompanying numbered plate provides the recorded figures associated with Crookgate Keep. Consult the plate for those figures rather than relying on the descriptive register above. The plate is authoritative for its assigned measurements and other numerical records.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For field identification, use the following order of recognition:</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Region: The Weeping Marshes.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Foundation: 294 AS.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Status: contested.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Rule: The Bleeding Crown.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Disposition: outside the realm’s core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Crookgate Keep is accordingly classified as a marshland stronghold under the rule of The Bleeding Crown, founded in 294 AS, and retained within the contested territories beyond the realm’s core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Crookvale</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Crookvale is a highland settlement of The High Spires, founded in 295 AS. Its present structure is rebuilt, though the settlement has not been restored to the position of a core holding. Crookvale remains outside the core holdings and is ruled by House Morvain.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The settlement’s rebuilt structure bears a crooked, hard-edged identity suited to a highland settlement. Its lines, defenses, and clustered construction present no impression of softness or ease. Crookvale appears shaped by necessity rather than ornament. Angles dominate its visible profile, and the whole settlement conveys the impression of having been forced into continued use after destruction.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its demeanor is wary and resilient. Crookvale behaves as though survival has become its governing principle. Access, stores, and defenses are treated as matters requiring scrutiny. Local custom favors endurance over display, and authority is most readily recognized when it demonstrates practical control. The settlement does not project confidence; it projects persistence.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" 1004 is the clearest expression of Crookvale’s present function. It is not merely a population center with defensive personnel attached. The garrison defines the settlement’s public posture, reinforcing its guarded character and maintaining the distinction between a secure approach and an exposed one. The record does not assign Crookvale a place among the core holdings; its significance instead rests upon its continued occupation and defense.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>House Morvain’s rule is therefore visible through administration, discipline, and the maintenance of the rebuilt settlement. Crookvale’s crooked form should not be mistaken for disorder. Its irregularity is functional, and its severity is consistent with a community that has outlasted damage without abandoning caution.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For travelers, Crookvale is best understood as a settlement of controlled access and limited assurance. Its inhabitants are wary, its defenses are maintained, and its rebuilt character remains evident in every hard-edged line. The settlement offers endurance rather than welcome, and continuity rather than comfort. The settlement holds its ground amid that dispute; this is its defining civic posture.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For gazetteer purposes, Gloammarch should be recorded as a fortified core location of The Ash Wastes, founded in 321 AS, ruled by House Morvain, defended by a garrison strength of 2148, and retaining the status contested. Further claims regarding its jurisdiction, rivals, or future disposition are outside the certified record.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Gloamreach</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Classification</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Record</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Pale Coast</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>quarantined</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Garrison strength</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>2483</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ruling house</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>House Morvain</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>246 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Gloamreach is a core location on The Pale Coast, distinguished from the surrounding coast by its status as quarantined. Passage, commerce, and ordinary contact are consequently subject to guarded uncertainty. The settlement is not presented as an open coastal holding; its prevailing condition is one of enclosure and restriction.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The site bears the pallid, bleak visual character associated with The Pale Coast. Its structures, approaches, and exposed reaches carry the shadowed identity of the name Gloamreach. Light appears diminished there, whether by weather, architecture, or the apprehension of those who approach. This appearance is not ornamental. It reinforces the location’s sealed-off and ominous demeanor.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Gloamreach is ruled by House Morvain. Its garrison strength is 2483. This force is the principal visible measure of the location’s guarded condition, though the record does not reduce Gloamreach to a military station. Its quarantine and isolation define its public character as strongly as its walls, watch-posts, and controlled approaches.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The founding record is exact: Gloamreach's founded is 246 AS. Popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise. Such accounts are not accepted by this gazetteer and do not supersede the established date of 246 AS.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Condition</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Codex assessment</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Coastal identity</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Pallid and bleak</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Civic demeanor</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Sealed-off and ominous</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>External impression</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Isolated</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Governing uncertainty</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Guarded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Distinguishing designation</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>quarantined</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>The location’s separation from the surrounding coast is therefore both administrative and perceptual. Gloamreach is marked by controlled distance: it stands within The Pale Coast, yet is set apart from it by quarantine. Visitors encounter not a conventional coastal settlement but a place whose boundaries are treated as consequential.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>No account of Gloamreach is complete without these fixed entries: Gloamreach - region: The Pale Coast; Gloamreach - garrison strength: 2483; Gloamreach - status: quarantined; Gloamreach ruled by House Morvain; Gloamreach - founded: 246 AS.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="4" name="Picture 4"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_09_location_greyfell_citadel.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId12"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Greyfell Citadel: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel is a derelict fortress-site in the Shattered Vale. It was founded in 62 AS, during the period in which fortified holdings were established amid the fractured territories left by the Sundering. Its surviving works occupy a position outside the realm’s core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Designation</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Recorded condition</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel - region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Shattered Vale</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel - founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>62 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel - status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>abandoned</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ruling house</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>House Morvain</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greyfell Citadel ruled by House Morvain. The association remains part of the site’s formal record despite the citadel’s present condition. No current administration, garrison, or active court is assigned to the ruin in the available gazetteer record.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The citadel’s visual identity is defined by grey stone, collapsed masonry, and grey-hued ruin set against the austere terrain of the Shattered Vale. Its walls are best understood as remnants of a stronghold rather than as a functioning defensive installation. Towers, courts, and retaining structures may persist in partial form, but the site conveys no ordinary signs of occupation. Weathered surfaces, vacant approaches, and the absence of maintained standards reinforce its status.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its former stronghold character has been reduced to abandonment. This distinction is material: Greyfell Citadel is not merely damaged, disused, or temporarily unoccupied. It is recorded as abandoned and lies outside the realm’s core holdings, where no central authority presently treats it as an active seat of power.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For purposes of regional classification, the citadel should be entered under the Shattered Vale rather than under any core territorial division. References to House Morvain identify the ruling association preserved in the record; they do not alter the site’s abandoned status.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The ruin’s atmosphere is one of old desolation. Grey stone dominates the remaining profiles, while broken elevations and empty interior spaces mark the distance between its former purpose and its current condition. The site may therefore be used as a landmark of diminished sovereignty: a place where the architecture of rule survives after rule itself has withdrawn.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Consult the accompanying numbered plate for the recorded figures associated with Greyfell Citadel. Those figures are not reproduced in this entry.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Greythrone</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Designation</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Record</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone - region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Gloaming Reach</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone - founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>313 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone - garrison strength</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>4672</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone - status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>contested</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone ruled by</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Ashen Vanguard</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone is a stronghold of the Gloaming Reach, founded in 313 AS. It stands outside the realm’s core holdings and occupies a position of continuing military and political consequence. Its status is contested. Authority is maintained under persistent challenge, and no inspection of the site should assume uncontested jurisdiction merely from the presence of its garrison.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The stronghold’s visual identity is unmistakable. Grey walls and elevated defensive masses rise from the Gloaming Reach in the form of a throne, giving the location its name and its prevailing impression. The structure appears less constructed than imposed upon the surrounding land: a seat of rule rendered in stone, ash-coloured masonry, and severe angles. Its silhouette is intended to communicate endurance, command, and refusal of surrender.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone is garrisoned by 4672 troops. This force constitutes the principal visible instrument of order within the stronghold. The garrison’s presence does not remove the location from the category of contested holdings; rather, it defines the conditions under which its authority is exercised. Patrols, gate controls, internal watches, and defensive readiness are treated as ordinary functions of the site.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Greythrone is ruled by The Ashen Vanguard. This designation records the governing power, not an uncontested settlement of all claims. The stronghold’s rule remains subject to constant pressure, and its administrative posture is consequently defensive, formal, and alert. Orders are issued with the expectation of scrutiny. Access, movement, and declarations of allegiance are matters of practical concern.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The surrounding reach reinforces this condition. Greythrone does not present itself as a secure centre from which influence naturally radiates. It is an exposed seat of authority, held beyond the realm’s core holdings and surrounded by the political uncertainty characteristic of contested ground. Its walls provide position and protection, but not finality.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Gazetteer classification: fortified location; external holding; contested jurisdiction; garrisoned seat of The Ashen Vanguard.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="5" name="Picture 5"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_06_location_hollowreach.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId13"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Hollowreach: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Hollowreach</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowreach lies in the Gloaming Reach, where the settlement’s presence is defined by restriction, silence, and maintained separation. It was founded in 56 AS and remains a core location under quarantine. Its condition is not incidental to its appearance: Hollowreach presents the stark visual identity of a quarantined settlement in the Gloaming Reach, with every visible aspect subordinated to containment.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Classification</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Record</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Location</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowreach</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Gloaming Reach</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>56 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>quarantined</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ruling power</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Iron-Ring Cartel</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowreach feels closed, isolated, and burdened by containment. Access is treated as an exception rather than a custom, and ordinary movement carries the visible weight of scrutiny. The settlement’s boundaries are understood less as civic limits than as instruments of quarantine. Within them, the distinction between resident, keeper, and permitted visitor is maintained with deliberate severity.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowreach is ruled by The Iron-Ring Cartel. This authority is recorded as administrative fact; the settlement’s sealed demeanor and regulated presentation are consistent with that condition. No competing claim is entered in the present gazetteer. The Cartel’s control does not make Hollowreach open or prosperous. It confirms only that the settlement is governed, monitored, and retained under an active state of quarantine.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The local atmosphere is one of suspension. Duties continue, but without the outward assurances associated with an unconfined settlement. Doors, routes, and gathering places possess the character of controlled points. Even when no inspection is visible, containment remains the governing assumption. The result is a place that appears to have withdrawn from the surrounding Reach without ceasing to belong to it.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The designation quarantined is therefore both a status and a defining condition. Hollowreach is not merely isolated by circumstance; its isolation is preserved as policy. The settlement’s identity is inseparable from the limits imposed upon it, and its stark appearance records those limits more clearly than any proclamation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The accompanying numbered plate records Hollowreach’s figures. w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Realm position</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Outside the realm’s core holdings</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowvale was founded in 286 AS in the Blood-Moor. Its establishment placed a permanent fortified settlement within a region defined by ominous terrain and difficult approaches. The vale’s position outside the realm’s core holdings gives it a distinct administrative and military character. It is not recorded as a central seat of power. Its principal function is the maintenance of a defended presence.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowvale is ruled by The Ashen Vanguard. Under that authority, the settlement remains garrisoned. Its garrison strength is 7594 troops, a substantial force by the standards of an outlying holding. The number indicates sustained readiness rather than a temporary muster. Personnel are assigned to the walls, approaches, watch stations, stores, and internal security. Exact distributions within the garrison are not recorded in this entry.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The visual identity of Hollowvale is that of a defended vale surrounded by the ominous landscape of the Blood-Moor. Defensive works define the settlement’s visible boundary. Towers, barriers, and controlled passages are arranged to make the vale legible as a military holding rather than an open habitation. The surrounding moor remains the dominant external feature, lending the settlement a compressed and watchful aspect.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Hollowvale projects guarded vigilance. This demeanor is sustained by its substantial garrison and by the persistent demands of its setting. Movement through the settlement is subject to observation. Access points are treated as matters of security. Civil functions exist within the limits imposed by defense, and the visible presence of armed personnel is a normal condition of local life.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The designation garrisoned is therefore both an official status and a practical description. Hollowvale is maintained as a defended location under The Ashen Vanguard, in the Blood-Moor, beyond the realm’s core holdings. Its founding date, regional placement, ruling power, and military strength establish its primary gazetteer classification. Further civic distinctions are subordinate to these recorded facts.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Ironfell Citadel</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ironfell Citadel is a fortified core location standing in The Weeping Marshes. It was founded in 320 AS and remains under the rule of House Morvain. The citadel’s present condition is recorded as quarantined, restricting ordinary access and limiting its external dealings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle location</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>The citadel’s visual identity is defined by the contrast between iron and marshland. Its walls, towers, gates, and defensive fittings present a hard, metallic impression, while the surrounding Weeping Marshes impose a bleak and sodden character upon the whole site. Surfaces appear dark beneath persistent damp. Metalwork is treated as a necessity rather than an ornament, and the structure’s severe lines are reinforced by the flat, waterlogged terrain around it.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ironfell Citadel feels closed and grim. Its organization favors containment, watchfulness, and controlled passage. The garrison of 1096 maintains the site under conditions suited to an inhospitable region, where distance, wet ground, and limited visibility reinforce the citadel’s guarded posture. No aspect of its presentation suggests welcome; the settlement is built to endure, observe, and deny access.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The quarantined status is central to all current assessments. It marks Ironfell Citadel as a location subject to isolation rather than ordinary movement or exchange. The designation does not alter its classification as a core location, but it governs how the citadel is approached and recorded. House Morvain’s rule is therefore exercised within a place defined by restriction, defensive readiness, and separation from the surrounding realm.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For gazetteer purposes, Ironfell Citadel is best understood as a Morvain-held stronghold whose identity derives equally from its metallic fortification and its marshbound environment. Its foundation in 320 AS, its garrison strength of 1096, and its quarantined status remain the principal fixed entries. All three conditions contribute to the citadel’s established character: durable, inaccessible, and grimly self-contained within The Weeping Marshes.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="6" name="Picture 6"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_00_location_marrowwatch.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId14"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Marrowwatch: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Marrowwatch</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwatch is a deserted watchhold in The Ash Wastes, founded in 280 AS. Its present status is abandoned. The site’s name remains attached to the remnant of a watch-post without a living garrison recorded.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>In formal territorial designation, Marrowwatch is ruled by The Ashen Vanguard. This designation does not alter the site’s present condition. No living garrison is recorded at Marrowwatch, and no active habitation is recognized in the available gazetteer record.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Register</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Recorded designation</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Location</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwatch</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Ash Wastes</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>280 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>abandoned</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Ruling power</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Ashen Vanguard</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>The watchhold appears empty and marrow-pale against the ash wastes. Its visible character is one of silence, desolation, and neglect. The structure is treated as a remnant rather than a functioning installation. Its condition provides no indication of active maintenance, regular occupation, or a present garrison.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwatch should therefore be classified as a ruled but abandoned location. The distinction is material: The Ashen Vanguard remains the recorded ruling power, while the site itself possesses no living garrison recorded in the surviving account. The name persists as a geographic and administrative designation, not as evidence of continued watchkeeping.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The surrounding wastes offer no correction to this assessment. Marrowwatch is defined by its empty appearance and by the absence of ordinary signs of occupation. Its marrow-pale surfaces stand apart from the ash, while the silence of the watchhold establishes its prevailing demeanor. Any assessment of the site should preserve these three entries as separate matters: its founding in 280 AS, its governance by The Ashen Vanguard, and its status as abandoned.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The accompanying numbered plate records the measured figures associated with Marrowwatch. Consult the plate for those figures. They are not reproduced in this entry.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For gazetteer purposes, Marrowwatch is entered under The Ash Wastes and retained as a location of the Ashen Era. Its surviving significance is terminological and territorial. The watchhold remains identifiable, its foundation remains dated, and its ruling power remains recorded; its garrison does not. In all other respects, the site is silent, desolate, and defined by neglect.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Marrowwell Abbey</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwell Abbey is a fortified religious site in The Gloaming Reach, maintained under the authority of The Bleeding Crown. It is classified as a rebuilt holding and is not a core holding. Its present condition reflects restoration after destruction or neglect, though surviving records do not establish the precise sequence of those changes.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Not a core holding</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>The rebuilt abbey has a severe, marrow-white presence beneath the dim character of The Gloaming Reach. Its walls and towers present little ornament. Pale stone, narrow apertures, and disciplined lines define the visible structure. The effect is not one of grandeur but of endurance. In poor light, the abbey may appear less constructed than exposed from the surrounding gloom.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwell Abbey feels grimly steadfast. Religious austerity governs its internal character, while military vigilance governs its external function. Devotion and defense are not treated as separate duties within the holding. Silence, watchfulness, and strict routine shape its daily operation. The garrison of 6656 confirms that the abbey is a major defended site, regardless of its exclusion from the category of core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The abbey’s authority is presently vested in The Bleeding Crown. Its allegiance is therefore to be recorded as Crown-held, with all associated obligations of defense and administration understood through that ruling power. No contrary jurisdiction is recognized in the gazetteer record.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Marrowwell Abbey's founded is 235 AS. Popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise. Such accounts are rejected. The foundation date remains 235 AS, and references that assign the abbey another founding year are erroneous.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The designation “rebuilt” is likewise material. Marrowwell Abbey is not to be catalogued as an untouched surviving structure. Its current form belongs to a later reconstruction, retaining the severe presence associated with the site while bearing the marks of renewal. The rebuilt condition does not lessen its strategic importance. It remains a vigilant stronghold in The Gloaming Reach, combining the disciplines of sanctuary and garrison under the rule of The Bleeding Crown.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="7" name="Picture 7"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_11_location_mournwatch.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId15"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Mournwatch: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch is a guarded settlement in the Gloaming Reach. Its position places it outside the realm’s core holdings, where the settlement’s function is defined by watchfulness, endurance, and military presence. The surrounding region bears the dim character of the Gloaming Reach, and Mournwatch reflects that condition in both appearance and demeanor.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" w:lastRow="0" w:noHBand="0" w:noVBand="1" w:val="04A0"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/><w:gridCol w:w="4320"/></w:tblGrid><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Register</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Recorded entry</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Location</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Region</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Gloaming Reach</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Status</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>garrisoned</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Rule</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>The Bleeding Crown</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr><w:tr><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>Founded</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:type="dxa" w:w="4320"/></w:tcPr><w:p><w:r><w:t>232 AS</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch is garrisoned. Its defenses, sentries, and maintained readiness are not incidental features but essential elements of its settled identity. The settlement presents as guarded rather than open, with its visual character shaped by containment and vigilance. The Gloaming Reach gives the site a subdued aspect; Mournwatch’s structures and approaches remain under a dim atmospheric character that reinforces its severe reputation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch maintains a somber, vigilant atmosphere. This demeanor is consistent across its public aspect and its daily condition. Activity is measured, observation is constant, and the settlement’s visible order is that of a place prepared to endure uncertainty. No festive or ornamental character is recorded as defining the site.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch is ruled by The Bleeding Crown. Its status as a garrisoned settlement and its location outside the realm’s core holdings are both recorded without qualification. These classifications distinguish Mournwatch from an unguarded rural holding or an ordinary interior settlement. Its importance is therefore expressed through position and readiness rather than through any recorded claim of centrality.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Mournwatch's founded is 232 AS. Popular accounts wrongly claim otherwise. Such accounts are rejected by this gazetteer. The accepted foundation record is 232 AS, and no competing date is recognized in the official register.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The settlement’s visual identity should be read in conjunction with its regional setting: a guarded habitation beneath the dim character of the Gloaming Reach. This is not merely a description of its buildings or defenses. It is the established impression by which Mournwatch is identified in records, reports, and regional surveys.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For the recorded figures associated with Mournwatch, consult the accompanying numbered plate. No distinction is made between the surviving sacred structure and its defensive additions: together, they constitute the abbey known to current surveys.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Palewell Abbey is ruled by The Silent Choir. bears the stark, pale identity of a coastal abbey fortified for war. Its surfaces and major outlines present little softness. Pale masonry, severe lines, and defensive construction dominate the visible character of the site. The effect is not ornamental. The abbey’s architecture communicates endurance, enclosure, and readiness.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its demeanor is austere and watchful, more garrison than sanctuary. Religious purpose remains legible in the name and form of the establishment, but the prevailing impression is one of controlled vigilance. Movement through the grounds is consequently read in military terms: entrances, walls, and occupied positions carry greater visual weight than cloisters or devotional spaces.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The garrison strength of Palewell Abbey is 5998. The two entries describe separate conditions: one concerns military presence, the other administrative classification.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Palewell Abbey should therefore be catalogued as a rebuilt coastal religious fortress under The Silent Choir, founded in 244 AS, situated in The Pale Coast, and maintained by a garrison of 5998. identity is that of a fortified settlement shaped by the harsh character of The Ash Wastes. Walls, defensive works, and occupied military spaces dominate its presentation. Ash is not incidental to Stormmarch’s appearance; it informs the settlement’s surfaces, outlook, and general aspect. The result is a place that appears constructed to resist both the surrounding wastes and the consequences of prolonged isolation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Stormmarch is ruled by The Ashen Vanguard. Its garrison strength is 9263, a substantial military presence held within a settlement that is nevertheless quarantined. This condition governs Stormmarch’s practical character. Strength is maintained, but not freely projected. The garrison remains beneath restriction, and the stronghold is sealed away from ordinary movement.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Stormmarch is also outside the realm’s core holdings. This distinction is administrative as well as geographic in effect: the settlement belongs to the contested remainder of the realm rather than to its central, regularly integrated territories. Its authority is therefore expressed through occupation and containment rather than through broad civic reach.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The prevailing demeanor of Stormmarch is severe and sealed. Military readiness is evident, yet access is controlled; the settlement’s power is held beneath quarantine rather than displayed through expansion. Its walls and garrison communicate persistence, while its isolation communicates danger or necessary restraint without resolving either condition.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For gazetteer purposes, Stormmarch should be treated as a quarantined stronghold of The Ashen Vanguard, founded in 71 AS and situated in The Ash Wastes. The name and the prevailing aspect are treated as mutually reinforcing in gazetteer records: Thorncairn presents itself as a place of hard contours, withdrawn presence, and limited welcome.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Thorncairn was founded in 192 AS. The ruling designation establishes the recognized power over the location; it does not, by itself, describe the full operation of that power within the quarantine.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The place’s demeanor is forbidding and withdrawn. A surveyor may identify Thorncairn by its regional placement, foundation date, classification, status, and ruling power, yet such identification should not be mistaken for ordinary admission.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The accompanying numbered plate contains the recorded figures associated with Thorncairn. All further impressions remain subordinate to these records.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Vharencrag Fortress</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Vharencrag Fortress is a core location of the High Spires, established during the early centuries of the Ashen Era. It feels watchful and strained, as if every road, shoreline approach, and internal passage demands continued scrutiny. The garrison’s duty is consequently understood through defense as much as through display. Blackford is caught between military defense and unresolved conflict; neither condition can be treated as temporary by default.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Blackford is ruled by The Bleeding Crown. This rule is recorded as fact, while the contested status remains in force. The two entries should be read together: the identity of the ruler does not remove the dispute surrounding the settlement.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>At close range, Blackford’s austerity is more evident than any civic grandeur. Dark surfaces and severe lines stand against the pale coast. The settlement appears built for endurance, observation, and refusal of easy approach. Weather may obscure its edges, but does not soften its reputation. Servants, soldiers, and residents conduct ordinary business under the pressure of a place that is continually required to demonstrate its value.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Gazetteer classification is therefore precise: Blackford is a core location of The Pale Coast, founded in 159 AS, garrisoned by 3065, and ruled by The Bleeding Crown. Its status is contested. Its appearance is stark and dark. Its prevailing demeanor is watchful and strained. All further assessments should preserve these distinctions.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Cindermere Hold</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Cindermere Hold is a ruined fortress of The High Spires. It was founded in 246 AS, when the elevated reaches were still considered suitable for a permanent military work. Its position combines defensive height with severe exposure: the hold stands apart from ordinary settlement and access routes, its surviving structure reduced to a stark silhouette against the surrounding stone and sky.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" w:firstRow="1" w:lastColumn="0" That figure records the scale of its former military establishment, not its present occupancy. The hold is now abandoned and is not a core holding. Its empty chambers, breached approaches, and unmaintained defenses provide no evidence of an active garrison.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>In appearance, Cindermere Hold combines the blackened severity of cinders with the elevated isolation of the High Spires. Its walls retain the impression of disciplined construction, though weathering and neglect have altered their original surfaces. Dark masonry, broken towers, and high ledges form a profile that remains legible at a distance. The structure is therefore recognized less by habitation than by its imposing outline.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The hold’s demeanor is one of immense former strength hollowed into ruin. Its scale exceeds its current function. Heavy defensive works remain where they can, but their silence emphasizes the loss of the force that once occupied them. Empty parapets and roofless interior spaces convey endurance without recovery.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Administrative records place Cindermere Hold under The Ashen Vanguard. This designation concerns the hold’s ruling authority and does not change its abandoned status or its classification as not a core holding. The site remains a military relic within The High Spires: a fortress whose elevation has preserved its visibility, while its isolation has sharpened the impression of abandonment.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Cindermere Hold is consequently catalogued as a former stronghold rather than an active seat of power. Its importance derives from the contrast between its documented garrison strength of 8878 and its present condition. The surviving silhouette expresses that contrast without ambiguity: blackened severity, elevated isolation, and immense former strength hollowed into ruin.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="1" name="Picture 1"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_03_location_crookgate_keep.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId9"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Crookgate Keep: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Crookgate Keep</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Crookgate Keep is a fortified location in the Weeping Marshes, founded in 294 AS. holdings</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl><w:p><w:r><w:t>The keep’s visual identity is inseparable from the bleak character of the Weeping Marshes. Its walls, towers, and enclosed approaches are read against wet ground, dim horizons, and the persistent severity of the surrounding landscape. The result is not an isolated architectural style, but a place whose appearance is defined by its setting. Crookgate Keep presents as a stronghold made severe by the marsh around it.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its demeanor is correspondingly uncertain. The atmosphere of Crookgate Keep is marked by its contested status: authority is present, but the permanence of that authority is not treated as settled. Records therefore describe the keep through condition rather than confidence. It is held, but not regarded as secure; administered, but not removed from dispute. This uncertainty is a defining feature of the location and should be considered alongside its formal designation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The keep’s position outside the realm’s core holdings further determines its gazetteer classification. Crookgate Keep is not entered among the central possessions of the realm. Its geographic separation and contested status are recorded as distinct conditions, neither replacing the other.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The accompanying numbered plate provides the recorded figures associated with Crookgate Keep. Consult the plate for those figures rather than relying on the descriptive register above. The plate is authoritative for its assigned measurements and other numerical records.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For field identification, use the following order of recognition:</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Region: The Weeping Marshes.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Foundation: 294 AS.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Status: contested.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Rule: The Bleeding Crown.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListBullet"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Disposition: outside the realm’s core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Crookgate Keep is accordingly classified as a marshland stronghold under the rule of The Bleeding Crown, founded in 294 AS, and retained within the contested territories beyond the realm’s core holdings.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Crookvale</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Crookvale is a highland settlement of The High Spires, founded in 295 AS. Its present structure is rebuilt, though the settlement has not been restored to the position of a core holding. Crookvale remains outside the core holdings and is ruled by House Morvain.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The settlement’s rebuilt structure bears a crooked, hard-edged identity suited to a highland settlement. Its lines, defenses, and clustered construction present no impression of softness or ease. Crookvale appears shaped by necessity rather than ornament. Angles dominate its visible profile, and the whole settlement conveys the impression of having been forced into continued use after destruction.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its demeanor is wary and resilient. Crookvale behaves as though survival has become its governing principle. Access, stores, and defenses are treated as matters requiring scrutiny. Local custom favors endurance over display, and authority is most readily recognized when it demonstrates practical control. The settlement does not project confidence; it projects persistence.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblStyle w:val="LightGrid-Accent3"/><w:tblW w:type="auto" w:w="0"/><w:tblLook w:firstColumn="1" 1004 is the clearest expression of Crookvale’s present function. It is not merely a population center with defensive personnel attached. The garrison defines the settlement’s public posture, reinforcing its guarded character and maintaining the distinction between a secure approach and an exposed one. The record does not assign Crookvale a place among the core holdings; its significance instead rests upon its continued occupation and defense.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>House Morvain’s rule is therefore visible through administration, discipline, and the maintenance of the rebuilt settlement. Crookvale’s crooked form should not be mistaken for disorder. Its irregularity is functional, and its severity is consistent with a community that has outlasted damage without abandoning caution.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For travelers, Crookvale is best understood as a settlement of controlled access and limited assurance. Its inhabitants are wary, its defenses are maintained, and its rebuilt character remains evident in every hard-edged line. The settlement offers endurance rather than welcome, and continuity rather than comfort. In the records of The High Spires, Crookvale stands as a rebuilt holding whose governing principle is survival.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><wp:extent cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/><wp:docPr id="2" name="Picture 2"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="0" name="plate_05_location_embercrag_fortress.png"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId10"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="4114800" cy="4090394"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"/></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Plate - Embercrag Fortress: consult the plate for the recorded figures.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/></w:pPr><w:r><w:t>Embercrag Fortress</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Embercrag Fortress stands in The Shattered Vale, a ruinous region whose broken terrain gives the site its severe character. No active garrison, court, or civil administration is presently recorded at the site.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The fortress is abandoned. Embercrag feels empty and desolate, its abandonment hanging over the ruin like a final sentence. This condition should not be mistaken for an absence of jurisdiction in the historical record. Embercrag Fortress is ruled by The Silent Choir, whose authority remains the recognized ruling association for the location. The relationship between recorded rule and present occupation is therefore administrative rather than demonstrably residential.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Embercrag Fortress is not a core location. It is catalogued as a peripheral site within the Shattered Vale, relevant for regional surveys, territorial records, and the study of abandoned strongholds. Its designation does not diminish its inclusion in formal gazetteer records; it indicates only that the fortress does not constitute one of the principal locations used to define the region’s central structure.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The fortress’s appearance is inseparable from the scorched, crag-bound impression conveyed by its name. The site is accordingly classified by condition and record, not by current habitation.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For the recorded figures associated with Embercrag Fortress, consult the accompanying numbered plate. This rule is to be understood as a claim of authority over an abandoned site outside the realm’s core holdings, not as evidence of a functioning settlement administration. No further institutional character is assigned in this entry.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The settlement’s visual identity is an empty habitation bearing the stark character of the Shattered Vale. Walls, lanes, and rooflines are present only as remnants or vacant forms; the site offers no reliable sign of ordinary continuity. Its condition is consistent with long neglect, though the codex assigns no additional cause beyond its recorded status.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The atmosphere of Emberdeep is silent and forsaken. Sound carries without answer. The absence of residents, trade, and visible administration is the defining condition of the site. These qualities are not treated as temporary measures but as the ordinary expression of Embermarch’s garrisoned status.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The founding date of 67 AS places Embermarch within the post-Sundering record and establishes its earliest recognized entry in the gazetteer. No current administration, garrison, or active court is assigned to the ruin in the available gazetteer record.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>The citadel’s visual identity is defined by grey stone, collapsed masonry, and grey-hued ruin set against the austere terrain of the Shattered Vale. Its walls are best understood as remnants of a stronghold rather than as a functioning defensive installation. Towers, courts, and retaining structures may persist in partial form, but the site conveys no ordinary signs of occupation. Weathered surfaces, vacant approaches, and the absence of maintained standards reinforce its status.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>Its former stronghold character has been reduced to abandonment. This distinction is material: Greyfell Citadel is not merely damaged, disused, or temporarily unoccupied. It is recorded as abandoned and lies outside the realm’s core holdings, where no central authority presently treats it as an active seat of power.</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:p><w:r><w:t>For purposes of regional classification, the citadel should be entered under the Shattered Vale rather than under any core territorial division.
